subject: ApexCloud partnership discovery — coordinating next meeting and owners
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexcloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Nitin Rao <nrao@apexcloud.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery (ApexCloud <> Redwood) — next steps

Camila / Jonas — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and asks so we can lock the next session: 

- Why we called: evaluate Redwood for a marketplace-backed inference endpoint. Primary asks are predictable latency for multi-tenant marketplace workloads and data isolation options.
- Internal Apex attendees who want to join the technical deep dive: Nitin Rao (lead infra engineer) and Sarah Kim (security).
- Must-know constraints: Apex requires a documented path for tenant isolation (VPC or equivalent) and a list of encryption/KMS options for production.

What we want next: a partner-led technical deep dive + a short product demo targeted at marketplace integration patterns. Proposed times that work for our team:
  • Tue Dec 7 — 09:00–10:00 PT
  • Wed Dec 8 — 13:00–14:00 PT

Attachments: discovery-notes-apex.pdf (notes from our internal prep).

Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the demo vs the deeper technical session? Also — are you able to share a short agenda so we can confirm internal attendees.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships | ApexCloud
priya.shah@apexcloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexcloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery (ApexCloud <> Redwood) — next steps

Priya — great to connect, and thanks for the clear recap. Quoting your options and confirming next steps below.

Availability: Wed Dec 8 13:00–14:00 PT works best for our team — we can hold that slot if that works for you.

Owners and asks: 
- Demo owner (marketplace patterns / product overview): Jonas Weber (Solutions Engineering).
- Technical deep dive owner (integration, networking, KMS): Vanessa Ortiz (Partner Engineer).

Proposed short agenda (30–45m):
1) 10m — Marketplace integration patterns (Jonas)
2) 20–25m — Technical deep dive and Q&A (Vanessa + Nitin)
3) 5–10m — Next steps & mutual action plan alignment (Camila)

I've attached a draft mutual action plan to get ahead of scope and deliverables (APEX-MAP-v0.3.docx). If you can share any SSO/KMS contact and an internal list of scopes you want covered in the deep dive, Vanessa will tailor the agenda.

If Dec 8 13:00 PT is confirmed, I'll send a calendar invite and include the owners above.

—Camila Reyes
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexcloud.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery (ApexCloud <> Redwood) — technical scope

Thanks Priya / Camila — quick note from the engineering side.

Will join Dec 8 and plan to cover:
- Tenant isolation options: VPC peering patterns, Private Deployments, and our Dedicated offering behavior in marketplace contexts.
- KMS/HSM integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS; customer-managed keys).
- Expected latency profiles for multi-tenant vs. dedicated pools; we'll include a few benchmark numbers and recommended configs.

Can you confirm whether Apex prefers a walkthrough of our VPC option or an on-prem sim (we can demo both conceptually)? Also, please send any network diagrams or current marketplace onboarding docs you have — that will help us prepare targeted examples.

Attachments: SLA-summary.pdf (high-level SLA + escalation points).

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexcloud.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery (ApexCloud <> Redwood) — calendar invite sent

Thanks all — confirmed Wed Dec 8 at 13:00 PT for a partner-led session. I've created the invite and included the agenda Camila proposed. Calendar invite attached as calendar-invite-APX-4987.ics and invite includes the following attendees: Jonas Weber (demo), Vanessa Ortiz (technical deep dive), Camila Reyes (partner lead), Priya Shah, Nitin Rao, Sarah Kim.

Action items: 
- Camila: please review the MAP and confirm the milestones on slide 2.
- Priya: send any network diagrams and the preferred SSO contact to Vanessa by EOD Dec 3.
- Vanessa: prepare a short benchmark slide (multi-tenant vs dedicated) plus KMS options.

Also sharing a DocuSign link for a mutual NDA to speed up any technical access: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

See you on Dec 8.

Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
